title: 斗鹅
slug: 姜姬全本免费-姜姬最新章节列表
content_zh:
她唯一知道的就是昨晚姜元和蒋伟谈得不是很好，其间蒋伟自己说了很多，语气中的轻蔑都快透出来了，而姜元半句都没吭，最后不知蒋伟说到什么，姜元突然大怒，冯丙也从天而降来帮腔，蒋伟和冯丙就这么走了，姜元……大概算是吵赢了吧？
到了早晨，她本以为昨天吵成那样，今天三人不可能再排排坐吃果果，结果到早上蒋伟和冯丙像没事人一样又带着他们队伍里做好的早饭来了，姜元也一脸笑意的请他们同进早餐。
你们这些人……
姜姬是大写的服。
早饭过后，姜姬被姜元赶出来“玩”了，姜姬只好叫上姜武出去“散步”。
山脚下的人似乎越来越多了，姜姬突然听到了鸭子的叫声，她让姜武把她抱高，看到山脚下似乎正有不少新的家畜家禽被赶往这里，一群群的像白云落在碧绿的草地上。
“我们去那里。”姜姬迫不及待的想看看了。
她到这里来以后只见过野生的，一般不是下锅就是逃出了姜武和姜奔的陷阱，一下看到这么多家禽家畜真是惊喜啊！
姜武也好奇，就背着姜姬大步往山脚下跑。
跑近了就能看到山脚下的队伍泾渭分明，一个占据了东边，一个占据了南边，分别是两条下山的道路。这些人用车围成一圈，在车里埋火做饭，很多人都是席地而卧，远远的看到姜武跑下来，那些躺在地上的人立刻都爬起来了。
冯家展用看到这一幕立刻狂奔而来，一边跑一边喊：“休要失礼！”然后远远的冲过来扑倒在地，行了一个震撼的五体投地大礼！
姜姬在姜武背上看到都忍不住倒抽一口冷气：嘴里肯定吃到土了！
姜奔在山坡上看到姜武竟然敢背着姜姬跑下山了，急得直跺脚，又不敢追下去，只好站在廊下喊：“爹！姜武把姜姬背到山下去了！”他话音未落，蒋伟第一个跑出来，姜元都比他慢了一步。
蒋伟昨晚回去觉都没睡，先派人回家送信，一是说他们找到姜元了，二来是让人查一下姜元身边曾经出现过的女人，有没有身份比较特殊的。
不过他自己也猜了一圈，多多少少有了一点底。
要是真的，那姜姬的身份可是仅次于姜元的，而且一个女公子可比一个小公子更要有用得多。
冯丙慢了一步，只好先开口，“大公子不必担心，展用在下头呢。”
姜元：“可是你那从人？”
冯丙道，“正是。”
蒋伟也道，“大公子放心，我家的从人都很灵巧，不会冒犯女公子。”

姜奔听不懂，还是一脸急色。
姜元对他道，“没事，你妹妹性子活泼，有姜武跟着，不会出事。”
姜奔觉得姜武太大胆，但姜元这么说，好像姜武并没错？他只好站到一旁。
有展用的五体投地，其他人也都早早的行礼，有像展用一样五体投地式，也有简单的拱手为礼，还有一些人没有行礼，而是远远的避开了，这些人多数都带着一柄重剑或其他武器。
姜姬说：“请起。”
这些简单的话，姜元都教给了她，不过她也就会这几句。
她拍拍姜武，以小卖小，指着前方的鹅群：“走！”
那些抱剑的人看到姜武背着姜姬跑向鹅群，竟然都笑了起来，还有两个人吹起长长的口哨。鹅群中有鹅听到口哨声，立刻扭头往这边看，然后口哨声似乎打起了转，那些鹅竟然开始转向！径直往姜姬他们涌来！
展用惊跳起来，指着刚才吹口哨的两人喊：“焦翁！你大胆！”
那焦翁看展用跳脚大骂还大笑出声。
姜武见鹅转过来就背着姜姬掉头跑，展用已经牵来马拿着弓箭追了上来。姜武跑着，姜姬给他说：“有个人追上来了，他有弓箭！”
姜武跑得快，瞬间就把鹅给甩掉一大段，他往山坡上跑，对姜姬说：“我把你放下，你自己往上跑。”
姜姬：“你一个人怎么办？”
没想到姜武咽了口口水说：“这可比鸟大多了！”
姜姬：“……好！”她也条件反射的咽了口口水。
接着姜武把她往地上一放，她转头拔足狂奔，听到身后姜武已经跑向鹅群！

content_en:
The only thing she knew was that Jiang Yuan and Jiang Wei didn't talk very well last night. Jiang Wei talked a lot, and the contempt in his tone almost came out, but Jiang Yuan didn't say a word. In the end, she didn't know what Jiang Wei said. Jiang Yuan suddenly became furious, and Feng Bing came down from the sky to help. Jiang Wei and Feng Bing just left. Jiang Yuan...probably won the argument, right?
In the morning, she thought that after the quarrel yesterday, it would be impossible for the three of them to sit in a row and eat fruit today. However, in the morning, Jiang Wei and Feng Bing came back with the breakfast prepared by their team as if nothing had happened. Jiang Yuan also invited them to have breakfast with a smile on his face.
You people...
Jiang Ji is capitalized.
After breakfast, Jiang Ji was kicked out by Jiang Yuan to "play", so Jiang Ji had to ask Jiang Wu to go out for a "walk".
There seemed to be more and more people at the foot of the mountain. Jiang Ji suddenly heard the quacking of ducks. She asked Jiang Wu to lift her up. She saw that there seemed to be many new livestock and poultry being driven here at the foot of the mountain. Groups of them were like white clouds falling on the green grass.
"Let's go there." Jiang Ji couldn't wait to take a look.
She has only seen wild ones since she came here, usually either getting into the pot or escaping from the traps of Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben. It was such a surprise to see so many poultry and livestock at once!
Jiang Wu was also curious, so he ran towards the foot of the mountain with Jiang Ji on his back.
As you get closer, you can see that the teams at the foot of the mountain are clearly divided. One occupies the east side and the other occupies the south side. They are two roads going down the mountain. These people formed a circle in a car and made a fire in the car to cook. Many people were lying on the ground. When they saw Jiang Wu running down from a distance, those lying on the ground immediately got up.
When Feng Jiazhan saw this scene, he immediately ran over, shouting as he ran, "Don't be rude!" Then he rushed over from a distance and threw himself to the ground, giving a shocking five-body salute!
Jiang Ji couldn't help but gasp when she saw Jiang Wu's back: There must be dirt in her mouth!
On the hillside, Jiang Ben saw Jiang Wu dare to carry Jiang Ji down the mountain. He stamped his feet anxiously, but he did not dare to pursue him. He had to stand in the corridor and shouted: "Dad! Jiang Wu carried Jiang Ji down the mountain!" Before he could finish his words, Jiang Wei ran out first, and Jiang Yuandu was one step slower than him.
Jiang Wei didn't even sleep after returning home last night. He first sent someone home to deliver a message. Firstly, he said that they had found Jiang Yuan. Secondly, he asked someone to check whether any of the women who had appeared around Jiang Yuan had a special status.
However, he also made some guesses himself, and he was more or less confident.
If it is true, then Jiang Ji's status is second only to Jiang Yuan, and a female young master is much more useful than a young master.
Feng Bing was a step too slow and had no choice but to speak first, "Young master, don't worry, I'll put it to good use below."
Jiang Yuan: "But your servant?"
Feng Bing said, "Exactly."
Jiang Wei also said, "Don't worry, eldest son, my servants are very smart and will not offend the female master."
Jiang Ben didn't understand, but still looked anxious.
Jiang Yuan said to him, "It's okay. Your sister is lively and with Jiang Wu following her, nothing will happen."
Jiang Ben felt that Jiang Wu was too bold, but when Jiang Yuan said this, it seemed that Jiang Wu was not wrong? He had to stand aside.
Some people bowed to the ground like Zhan Yong, and others also saluted early. Some people bowed to the ground like Zhan Yong, and some simply raised their hands in salute. Some people did not salute, but stayed away from each other. Most of these people carried a heavy sword or other weapons.
Jiang Ji said: "Please get up."
Jiang Yuan taught her these simple words, but she only knew these few words.
She patted Jiang Wu and pointed at the group of geese in front of her: "Let's go!"
When those people holding swords saw Jiang Wu carrying Jiang Ji running towards the geese, they all laughed, and two people whistled long whistles. Some geese in the group heard the whistle and immediately turned their heads to look this way. Then the whistle seemed to spin, and the geese started to turn! Go straight to gingerJi and the others are coming!
Zhan Yong jumped up in surprise, pointed at the two people who had just whistled and shouted: "Jiao Weng! You are brave!"
When Jiao Weng saw the exhibition, he jumped on his feet and yelled and laughed loudly.
When Jiang Wu saw the goose turning around, he turned around and ran away with Jiang Ji on his back. Zhan Yong had already led a horse and chased after her with a bow and arrow. Jiang Wu was running, and Jiang Ji said to him: "Someone is catching up with him, and he has a bow and arrows!"
Jiang Wu ran so fast that he threw away a large section of the goose in an instant. He ran up the hillside and said to Jiang Ji, "I'll put you down and you can run up."
Jiang Ji: "What will you do alone?"
Unexpectedly, Jiang Wu swallowed and said, "This is bigger than a bird!"
Jiang Ji: "...Okay!" She also swallowed reflexively.
Then Jiang Wu put her on the ground, and she turned around and ran away. Behind her, she heard Jiang Wu running towards the geese!
